superseries: GSE129704 (S3.p1; also liver and soleus, not analyzed here)
paper_type: Scientific Data Data Descriptor: no differential-expression analysis, no DEG counts, no named DE genes, no threshold are reported
assay: bulk polyA RNA-seq, Illumina NextSeq 500 1x75 SE, STAR 2.6 to Rn6, HTSeq 0.10.0 reverse-stranded counts on Ensembl 93 (mito genes removed, 24,613 regions) (S2.5.p1, DA.p7-p8)
tissue: pooled bilateral T11-L4 DRG per animal (S2.3.p1)
organism_sex: female Sprague Dawley rats, 8-9 weeks at start (S2.1.p1)
primary_estimand: effect of exercise training (swimming; shallow water walking) on DRG gene expression in contusion-injured rats housed in locomotor-restricting cages: CONT SCI + SWIM vs CONT SCI and CONT SCI + SWW vs CONT SCI (S1.p2, S1.p3, S4.2.p1 'one appropriate for an examination of the effect of exercise on SCI')
planned_contrasts: CONT SCI + SWIM vs CONT SCI (S4.2.p1 comparison set; paper: no DE result reported)
CONT SCI + SWW vs CONT SCI (S4.2.p1 comparison set; paper: no DE result reported)
secondary_comparison_set: injury severity: TX SCI vs CONT SCI vs No SCI (S4.2.p1); not exercise
repeated_measure_unit: none; one pooled DRG sample per animal, independent animals; rats doubly housed by group (S2.2.p1) but cage pairs not recorded
timing: sacrifice 8.5 wk post-surgery (TX), 11.5 wk (No SCI, CONT SCI), 13.5 wk (SWIM, SWW) (S2.3.p1, S4.3.p1, FIG2); exercise 10 wk, 5 d/wk, 30 min/d from 2.5 wk post-injury (S2.2.p3)
normalization: DESeq2 RLE size factors; VST for PCA (S2.5.p1-p2, DA.p9)
paper_method: none for DE (descriptive: DESeq2 RLE-normalized expression, plotPCA); DESeq2 would be the natural route on these counts

paper_threshold.source_locator: none; no DE threshold in the paper

paper_results: PCA only: Fig 3b 66% variance separates CONT SCI + SWIM/SWW from No SCI/CONT SCI; Fig 3c 64% variance separates TX SCI from No SCI/CONT SCI (S4.2.p1). Paper acknowledges sacrifice time differs by condition and argues batch effects are low (S4.3.p1).
